**Chinese name:** 寒武纪科技股份有限公司 (Hánwǔjì Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Spun out of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Institute of Computing Technology in March 2016; originally supplied AI silicon IP to Huawei before going independent, Cambricon is now one of China's most closely watched Nvidia-alternative plays, briefly becoming China's most valuable listed company by market cap. Full-year 2025 revenue reached ¥6.497 billion with ¥2.059 billion net profit — its first clearly profitable year — and Q1 2026 alone brought ¥2.885 billion revenue (+159.6% YoY) and ¥1.013 billion net profit (+185% YoY), with operating cash flow swinging from -¥1.399 billion a year earlier to +¥834 million. Market capitalization stood around ¥597.4 billion (roughly $84B) at the end of Q1 2026.
:::

## What does this firm design?

AI accelerator chips spanning cloud training/inference and edge inference, positioned as a domestic substitute as US export controls restrict Nvidia GPU access in China.
